# The console's screens for a small panel (board.py SMALL: the 1.8" as 160x128), drawn from
# quorum.py's state like quorum_ui.py, whose drawing kit and colours this borrows. The plan is
# docs/quorum-ui/SCREENS.md, "a pocket signer, one fact per screen": the same flow and the same
# six rules, cut into more, smaller pages. pages_of() says what they are; quorum.py counts them
# for "see every page" exactly as it counts the big ones.
#
# Every screen: a 16 px header (what this is, and which page of how many), the page, and an 18 px
# footer. On a review the footer holds the knob's three actions, SIGN, REJECT and BACK, lit only
# while the knob is on them; SIGN is green only once every page has been seen.
import time
import lcd as L
import fonts as F
import blockies
import quorum_ui as B
from quorum_ui import c, txt, txt_r, txt_c, fit, para, rrect, pill, mark, warn_sign, logo, ident, short, page_colors

W, H = L.W, L.H
M = 5                           # side margin
R = W - M
TW = W - 2 * M
HEAD = 16                       # header strip
FOOT = H - 18                   # footer from here down
use = B.use


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- pages
def pages_of(e):
    """The small screen's pages for one transaction, in order: what it does, each call and each
    address in it on a page of its own, the calldata and its digest, who has approved, then the
    code to compare and the whole hash. A refused one: why, then its calls."""
    out = []
    for i, it in enumerate(e["r"]["items"]):
        out.append(("item", i))
        if it.get("amount") and it.get("text"):
            out.append(("text", i))
        if it.get("frm"):
            out.append(("frm", i))
        if it.get("to"):
            out.append(("to", i))
        if it.get("digest"):
            out.append(("calldata", i))
            out.append(("digest", i))
    if e["why"]:
        return [("refused", 0)] + out
    return [("head", 0)] + out + [("approvals", 0), ("verify", 0), ("hash", 0)]


def addr_lines(a):
    """40 hex as 3 four-character chunks a line: 0x7099 7970 c518 / 12dc 3a01 0c7d / ..."""
    h = a[2:].lower() if a.startswith("0x") else a.lower()
    ch = [h[i:i + 4] for i in range(0, len(h), 4)]
    return ["0x" + " ".join(ch[:3])] + ["  " + " ".join(ch[i:i + 3]) for i in range(3, len(ch), 3)]


def header(d, left, right, fill="surface", ink="text", sub="muted", gap=6):
    """The top strip: left in bold, right in small type; gap pixels kept free between them.
    Returns the x where the right-hand text starts."""
    d.fill_rect(0, 0, W, HEAD, c(fill))
    xr = R
    if right:
        txt_r(d, right, R, 0, "sans12", sub, fill)
        xr = R - F.width(right, "sans12")
    txt(d, fit(left, xr - gap - M, "bold14"), M, -2, "bold14", ink, fill)
    return xr


def footer_msg(d, q, bg="bg"):
    """The last message over the footer, if there is one. True when it drew."""
    if not q.msg:
        return False
    d.fill_rect(0, FOOT, W, H - FOOT, c(bg))
    txt_c(d, fit(q.msg, TW, "sans12"), FOOT + 1, "sans12", "warn", bg)
    return True


def footer_press(d, q, what, bg="bg"):
    """What a press does, after the knob's mark."""
    if footer_msg(d, q, bg):
        return
    B.knob_badge(d, M + 7, FOOT + 9, "raised", "text")
    x = txt(d, "press", M + 19, FOOT + 1, "sans12", "faint", bg)
    txt(d, what, x + 5, FOOT, "bold14", "text", bg)


def choices(d, q, items, focus, bg="bg"):
    """Pills the knob turns onto, right-aligned, the one in focus lit."""
    if footer_msg(d, q, bg):
        return
    B.knob_badge(d, M + 7, FOOT + 9, "raised", "text")
    x = R
    for key, label in reversed(items):
        on = key == focus
        x -= F.width(label, "sans12") + 12
        pill(d, label, x, FOOT + 1, "sans12", "stake" if on else "surface", "bg" if on else "muted")
        x -= 4


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- home
def draw_home(q):
    d = q.d
    d.fill(c("bg"))
    n_own, need = len(q.owners()), q.threshold()
    right = ("%d/%d" % (need, n_own)) if n_own else ""
    ok = q.net_ok
    xr = header(d, q.SAFE["name"], right, gap=14)
    d.ellipse(xr - 7, 8, 3, 3, c("ok" if ok else "bad"), True)
    todo = sum(1 for e in q.queue if q.waiting(e))
    y = HEAD + 2
    txt(d, ("WAITING \u00b7 %d" % todo) if todo else ("QUEUE" if ok else "OFFLINE"), M, y,
        "bold14" if todo else "sans12", "warn" if todo else ("muted" if ok else "bad"))
    if q.queue:
        txt_r(d, "%d queued" % len(q.queue), R, y + 2, "sans12", "faint")
    y = 38
    if not q.queue:
        mark(d, ok, 18, y + 22, 10)
        txt(d, "Nothing to sign" if ok else "No service", 34, y + 10, "bold14")
        if not ok:
            txt(d, fit(q.net_err, TW, "sans12"), M, y + 36, "sans12", "muted")
    rows = 2 if q.outside else 3
    top = max(0, min(q.sel - (rows - 1), len(q.queue) - rows))
    for i in range(top, min(len(q.queue), top + rows)):
        e = q.queue[i]
        lvl = "red" if e["why"] else e["r"]["level"]
        sel = i == q.sel and not q.foot
        fill = "raised" if sel else "surface"
        rrect(d, 2, y, W - 4, 22, 4, fill)
        if lvl != "ok":
            d.fill_rect(2, y + 4, 3, 14, c("bad" if lvl == "red" else "warn"))
        x = txt(d, "#%d" % e["n"], 8, y + 2, "mono13", "warn" if q.conflicts(e) else "faint", fill)
        if q.signed_by_me(e):
            st, sc = "done", "ok"
        elif e["h"] in q.declined:
            st, sc = "rej", "bad"
        elif e["why"]:
            st, sc = "\u2014", "bad"
        else:
            st, sc = "%d/%d" % (len(e["conf"]), q.threshold(e["w"])), "muted"
        txt_r(d, st, R - 2, y + 3, "sans12", sc, fill)
        xs = R - 2 - F.width(st, "sans12")
        what = ("Refused" if e["why"] else e["r"]["summary"])
        f = "bold14" if sel else "sans12"
        txt(d, fit(what, xs - x - 10, f), x + 5, y + (1 if sel else 3), f, {"red": "bad", "warn": "warn"}.get(lvl, "text"), fill)
        y += 24
    if q.outside:
        rrect(d, 2, y, W - 4, 22, 4, "warn_bg")
        warn_sign(d, 12, y + 11, 7)
        txt(d, fit("key used %d times elsewhere" % q.outside, W - 30, "sans12"), 24, y + 3, "sans12", "warn_text", "warn_bg")
    choices(d, q, (("owners", "Owners"), ("device", "Device")), q.foot)
    d.show()


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- review pages
def action_bar(q, bg):
    d = q.d
    ok, why = q.can_sign(q.cur)
    ready = ok and not q.unseen()
    d.fill_rect(0, FOOT, W, H - FOOT, c(bg))
    if footer_msg(d, q, bg):
        return
    ws = (58, 54, W - 4 - 58 - 54 - 4)
    x = 2
    for i, (label, on, off, ink_on) in enumerate((("SIGN", "ok" if ready else "raised", "surface", "on_ok" if ready else "text"),
                                                   ("REJECT", "bad_bar", "bad_bg", "on_bad"),
                                                   ("BACK", "raised", "surface", "text"))):
        focus = q.act == i
        fill = on if focus else off
        rrect(d, x, FOOT + 1, ws[i], H - FOOT - 2, 4, fill)
        if focus:
            d.rect(x, FOOT + 1, ws[i], H - FOOT - 2, c("text"))
        txt_c(d, label, FOOT + 1, "sans12", ink_on if focus else ("bad_muted" if i == 1 else "muted"), fill, x, x + ws[i])
        x += ws[i] + 2


def item_of(q, i):
    return q.cur["r"]["items"][i]


def who_page(d, q, label, a, pc, bg, y):
    """label, who the address is, then all of it."""
    name, lg, known = ident(q, a)
    x = txt(d, label, M, y, "sans12", pc["muted"], bg) + 5
    if lg:
        logo(d, lg, x + 6, y + 8, 6)
        txt(d, fit(name, R - x - 14, "bold14"), x + 14, y - 1, "bold14", pc["text"], bg)
    elif name:
        txt(d, fit(name, R - x, "bold14"), x, y - 1, "bold14", pc["text"], bg)
    elif label == "contract":
        txt(d, "unknown contract", x, y, "sans12", "warn" if bg == "bg" else pc["text"], bg)
    else:
        txt(d, "not in address book", x, y, "sans12", "warn" if bg == "bg" else pc["text"], bg)
    y += 20
    for line in addr_lines(a):
        txt(d, line, M, y, "mono13", pc["stake"], bg)
        y += 15


def draw_review(q):
    d, e = q.d, q.cur
    kind, i = q.pages[q.page]
    lvl = "ok"
    if kind in ("item", "text", "frm", "to", "calldata", "digest"):
        lvl = item_of(q, i)["level"]
    elif kind == "refused":
        lvl = "red"
    pc = page_colors(lvl)
    bg = pc["bg"]
    d.fill(c(bg))
    here = q.page + 1 if q.act is None else len(q.pages)
    head = "#%d" % e["n"]
    if kind in ("item", "text", "frm", "to", "calldata", "digest"):
        head += " " + item_of(q, i)["title"]
    elif kind == "head":
        head += " " + q.CFG["chains"].get(str(q.CHAIN), "")
    elif kind in ("approvals", "verify", "hash"):
        head += " " + kind
    header(d, head, "%d/%d" % (here, len(q.pages)), pc["head"], pc["on_head"], pc["on_head"] if lvl != "ok" else "muted")
    y = HEAD + 3
    if kind == "head":
        r = e["r"]
        con = r.get("contract")
        if con:
            name, lg, known = ident(q, con)
            if known and lg:
                logo(d, lg, M + 6, y + 8, 6)
                txt(d, fit(name, TW - 16, "sans12"), M + 15, y, "sans12", "ok")
            else:
                warn_sign(d, M + 6, y + 8, 7)
                txt(d, "unknown contract", M + 16, y, "sans12", "warn")
        else:
            txt(d, "transfer", M, y, "sans12", "muted")
        y += 18
        for line in F.wrap(r["summary"], TW, "bold18")[:3]:
            txt(d, line, M, y, "bold18", {"red": "bad", "warn": "warn"}.get(r["level"], "text"))
            y += 22
        reds = sum(1 for it in r["items"] if it["level"] == "red")
        if reds and y <= FOOT - 18:
            pill(d, "%d red page%s" % (reds, "s" if reds > 1 else ""), M, FOOT - 18, "sans12", "bad_bar", "on_bad")
    elif kind == "item":
        it = item_of(q, i)
        if e["why"]:
            pill(d, "only the service's claim", M, y, "sans12", "bad_bar", "on_bad")
            y += 18
        if it.get("amount"):
            a = it["amount"]
            f = "bold26" if F.width(a, "bold26") <= TW else "bold18"
            for line in F.wrap(a, TW, f)[:2]:
                txt(d, line, M, y, f, pc["stake"] if lvl == "red" else pc["text"], bg)
                y += F.height(f) - 6
        elif it.get("text"):
            para(d, it["text"], M, y, TW, "sans12", pc["text"], bg, 15, FOOT - 2)
        if it.get("amount") and not it.get("text") and it.get("contract") and y < FOOT - 18:
            name, lg, known = ident(q, it["contract"])
            txt(d, fit(("on " + name) if known else "unknown contract", TW, "sans12"), M, FOOT - 18, "sans12",
                pc["muted"] if known else "warn", bg)
    elif kind == "text":
        para(d, item_of(q, i)["text"], M, y, TW, "sans12", pc["text"], bg, 15, FOOT - 2)
    elif kind in ("frm", "to"):
        it = item_of(q, i)
        label = it.get("frm_label", "from") if kind == "frm" else it.get("label", "to")
        who_page(d, q, label, it[kind], pc, bg, y)
    elif kind == "calldata":
        it = item_of(q, i)
        txt(d, "function", M, y, "sans12", pc["muted"], bg)
        txt(d, it["selector"], M, y + 16, "bold26", pc["stake"], bg)
        txt(d, "%d bytes of calldata" % it["size"], M, y + 54, "sans12", pc["muted"], bg)
        txt(d, "compare the digest", M, y + 70, "sans12", pc["muted"], bg)
    elif kind == "digest":
        for line in B.hash_lines(item_of(q, i)["digest"], per=3):
            txt(d, line, M, y, "mono13", pc["text"], bg)
            y += 15
    elif kind == "approvals":
        have, need = len(e["conf"]), q.threshold()
        ok, why = q.can_sign(e)
        txt(d, "%d of %d" % (have, need), M, y - 1, "bold18")
        if q.signed_by_me(e):
            s, col = "you signed", "ok"
        elif not ok:
            s, col = "you can't sign", "bad"
        elif have >= need:
            s, col = "already enough", "ok"
        else:
            s, col = "yours: %d of %d" % (have + 1, need), "ok" if have + 1 >= need else "muted"
        txt_r(d, s, R, y + 4, "sans12", col)
        y += 25
        for a in q.owners()[:4]:
            done = a in e["conf"]
            nm = "You" if a == q.me else (ident(q, a)[0] or short(a))
            d.ellipse(M + 4, y + 8, 4, 4, c("ok" if done else ("stake" if a == q.me else "faint")), done)
            txt(d, fit(nm, TW - 14, "sans12"), M + 13, y, "sans12", "text" if done or a == q.me else "muted")
            y += 16
        if not ok and y <= FOOT - 16:
            txt(d, fit(why, TW, "sans12"), M, FOOT - 16, "sans12", "bad")
    elif kind == "verify":
        txt(d, "Check with the", M, y, "sans12", "muted")
        txt(d, "proposer: ends in", M, y + 14, "sans12", "muted")
        code = e["mine"][-8:]
        txt(d, code[:4], M, y + 30, "monob28", "stake")
        txt(d, code[4:], M, y + 58, "monob28", "stake")
        blockies.draw(d, e["mine"], R - 40, y + 36, 5)
    elif kind == "hash":                # the Safe tx hash, computed here
        y -= 1
        for line in B.hash_lines(e["mine"], per=3):
            txt(d, line, M, y, "mono13", "text")
            y += 15
    else:       # refused
        mark(d, False, M + 9, y + 10, 9)
        txt(d, "Refused", M + 24, y - 2, "bold18", "bad_text", bg)
        para(d, e["why"], M, y + 24, TW, "sans12", "bad_text", bg, 15, FOOT - 2)
    action_bar(q, bg)
    if q.state == "hold":
        draw_hold(q)
    d.show()


def draw_hold(q):
    d = q.d
    need = q.hold_need(q.cur)
    el = min(need, time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), q.hold_t0))
    red = need > q.HOLD_MS
    rrect(d, 8, 24, W - 16, 78, 8, "bad_bar" if red else "ok")
    rrect(d, 10, 26, W - 20, 74, 7, "surface")
    txt_c(d, "Keep holding", 30, "bold14", "text", "surface")
    rrect(d, 20, 56, W - 40, 10, 5, "raised")
    w = (W - 40) * el // need
    if w >= 10:
        rrect(d, 20, 56, w, 10, 5, "ok")
    txt_c(d, "%.1f s to go" % ((need - el) / 1000), 72, "sans12", "bad" if red else "muted", "surface")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- the rest
def draw_working(q, title, sub):
    d = q.d
    d.fill(c("bg"))
    rrect(d, W // 2 - 30, 24, 60, 6, 3, "raised")
    rrect(d, W // 2 - 30, 24, 36, 6, 3, "stake")
    txt_c(d, title, 38, "bold18")
    if q.cur:
        txt_c(d, fit("#%d %s" % (q.cur["n"], q.cur["r"]["summary"]), TW, "sans12"), 66, "sans12", "text")
    info = getattr(q, "work_info", None) or ()
    if info:                                    # the chip's own facts (quorum.chip_info): two fit here
        txt_c(d, fit(sub, TW, "sans12"), 84, "sans12", "muted")
        y = 100
        for line in info[:2]:
            txt_c(d, fit(line, TW, "sans12"), y, "sans12", "muted")
            y += 13
    else:
        para(d, sub, M, 84, TW, "sans12", "muted", "bg", 14, H)
    d.show()


def draw_result(q):
    d = q.d
    ok, title, lines = q.result
    d.fill(c("bg"))
    mark(d, ok, M + 12, 16, 12)
    txt(d, fit(title, TW - 30, "bold18"), M + 30, 4, "bold18")
    y = 34
    for k, s in enumerate(lines):
        for line in F.wrap(s, TW, "sans12"):
            if y > FOOT - 15:
                break
            txt(d, line, M, y, "sans12", ("ok" if ok else "bad") if k == 0 else "text")
            y += 14
    if not ok and q.unsent:
        choices(d, q, (("send", "Send again"), ("back", "Back")), ("send", "back")[q.ract])
    else:
        footer_press(d, q, "OK")
    d.show()


OWNERS_PER_PAGE = 4


def draw_owners(q):
    d = q.d
    d.fill(c("bg"))
    pages = q.owner_pages()
    q.opage = page = min(q.opage, pages - 1)
    header(d, "Owners", ("%d of %d" % (q.threshold(), len(q.owners())) if q.owners() else "") + (" \u00b7 %d/%d" % (page + 1, pages) if pages > 1 else ""))
    y = HEAD + 3
    for a in q.owners()[page * OWNERS_PER_PAGE:(page + 1) * OWNERS_PER_PAGE]:
        nm = ident(q, a)[0]
        x = txt(d, fit(nm or short(a), TW - 30, "bold14" if nm else "mono13"), M, y, "bold14" if nm else "mono13",
                "text" if nm else "warn")
        if a == q.me:
            pill(d, "you", x + 4, y + 1, "sans12", "stake", "bg")
        y += 20
    k = "key " + (q.fingerprint() or "none")
    if q.counter is not None:
        k += " \u00b7 use #%d" % q.counter
    txt(d, fit(k, TW, "sans12"), M, FOOT - 16, "sans12", "faint")
    footer_press(d, q, "Back")
    d.show()


def draw_device(q):
    import image, gc, chips
    d = q.d
    d.fill(c("bg"))
    header(d, "Device", image.IMAGE)
    name = q.chip["name"] + " " if q.chip else ""
    rows = [("chip", (name + (q.serial[-8:] if q.serial else (q.sig.name if q.sig else "none")))),
            ("slot", "%s%s %s" % (q.slot_label(), " locked" if q.row and q.row.get("locked") else "",
                                   chips.PROFILE_SHORT.get(q.profile, q.profile or "-"))),
            ("key", q.fingerprint() or "none"),
            ("pin", "ok" if q.pin_ok and q.EXPECT else ("dev: none" if q.pin_ok else "FAIL")),
            ("sec", "%d events" % q.sec) if q.sec is not None else
            ("uses", "#%d" % q.counter if q.counter is not None else "not counted"),
            ("free", "%d KB \u00b7 %s" % (gc.mem_free() // 1024, (image.VERSION or image.BUILD) + (" " + image.RELEASE[:4] if image.RELEASE else "")))]
    y = HEAD + 1
    for k, v in rows:
        txt(d, k, M, y, "sans12", "muted")
        txt_r(d, fit(v, TW - 36, "sans12"), R, y, "sans12", "bad" if v == "FAIL" else "text")
        y += 15
    if q.KNOB:
        choices(d, q, (("chip", "Chip"), ("back", "Back")), q.dfoot)
    else:
        footer_press(d, q, "Back")
    d.show()


def chip_layout(pages):
    """The Chip pages split so each fits the small screen, one row a line."""
    per = (FOOT - 14 - HEAD - 1) // 13 + 1
    out = []
    for title, rows in pages:
        for i in range(0, len(rows), per):
            out.append((title, rows[i:i + per]))
    return out


def draw_chip(q):
    """The Chip pages on the small screen: one value a line, cut to fit."""
    d = q.d
    d.fill(c("bg"))
    title, rows = q.chip_pages[q.chip_page]
    header(d, title, "%d/%d" % (q.chip_page + 1, len(q.chip_pages)))
    y = HEAD + 1
    for k, v in rows:
        if y > FOOT - 14:
            break
        txt(d, fit(k, 44, "sans12"), M, y, "sans12", "muted")
        txt(d, fit(str(v), TW - 48, "sans12"), M + 48, y, "sans12", "bad" if str(v).startswith(("FAILED", "MISSING")) else "text")
        y += 13
    footer_press(d, q, "Back")
    d.show()


def notice(q, ok, title, lines, press=None):
    """A plain page: a mark, a title and a few lines. The states where the console signs nothing."""
    d = q.d
    d.fill(c("bg"))
    mark(d, ok, M + 11, 13, 10)
    txt(d, fit(title, TW - 28, "bold18"), M + 27, 1, "bold18")
    y = 30
    for k, s in enumerate(lines):
        for line in F.wrap(s, TW, "sans12"):
            if y > FOOT - 15:
                break
            txt(d, line, M, y, "sans12", "text" if k == 0 else "muted")
            y += 14
    if press:
        footer_press(d, q, press)
    d.show()


def draw_nochip(q):
    notice(q, False, "No chip", ["No secure element answered on I2C.", "The console only signs with a key inside the chip."],
           "Check again")


def draw_pinfail(q):
    exp = q.EXPECT or {}
    title = "Not the pinned key" if q.EXPECT else ("Not a pinned chip" if q.EXPECTS else "Not pinned")
    lines = [q.pin_why or "", "here   " + (q.serial[-8:] or "none"), "pinned " + (str(exp.get("serial", ""))[-8:] or "-"),
             "Nothing will be signed." if q.EXPECT else "tools/fw pin adds this chip."]
    notice(q, False, title, lines, "Check again")


def draw_unconfigured(q):
    notice(q, False, "No Safe", ["secrets.py has no QUORUM_SAFES.", "docs/guide/SETUP.md"])


def draw_crashed(q, why=""):
    import image
    notice(q, False, "Stopped", ["Failed %d times in a row; signs nothing now." % q.fails, why[:40],
                                "build " + image.BUILD, "Hold the knob 3 s to restart."])


def draw(q):
    s = q.state
    if s == "nochip":
        draw_nochip(q)
    elif s == "pinfail":
        draw_pinfail(q)
    elif s == "unconfigured":
        draw_unconfigured(q)
    elif s == "crashed":
        draw_crashed(q)
    elif s == "chip":
        draw_chip(q)
    elif s == "device":
        draw_device(q)
    elif s in ("review", "hold"):
        draw_review(q)
    elif s == "result":
        draw_result(q)
    elif s == "owners":
        draw_owners(q)
    elif s == "working":
        draw_working(q, "Working", "")
    else:
        draw_home(q)

# A PicoQuorum release, as the project Safe approves it (docs/GOVERNANCE.md, docs/RELEASES.md).
# The Safe approves a release by signing its digest D as a Safe message: one ordinary Safe
# transaction, a delegatecall to Safe's SignMessageLib (signMessage(abi.encode(D))), which marks D
# signed for good. Anyone checks it with isValidSignature(D, "0x") on that Safe.
#
#   D = EIP-712 PicoQuorumRelease(string version, bytes32 firmware, bytes32 manifest)
#       domain {name: "PicoQuorum Release", version: "1"}
#   firmware: the console image's release fingerprint (tools/releases/fingerprint.mjs, image.RELEASE)
#   manifest: the SHA-256 of docs/releases/<version>.json, which lists every source file's hash and
#             the web builds' (written once by tools/release manifest, never changed after the tag)
#
# No chainId in this domain: the Safe's own message hash binds D to one Safe on one chain. The
# console learns the three fields from the transaction's origin note, which anyone can write, so
# decode.py recomputes D from them and refuses unless it is exactly the D in the calldata. Pure, so
# test-vectors/run.py checks it against viem on CPython and MicroPython.
from keccak import keccak256

_domain = None
VERSION_CHARS = "0123456789."


def _b32(h):
    if isinstance(h, (bytes, bytearray)):
        b = bytes(h)
    else:
        b = bytes.fromhex(h[2:] if h.startswith("0x") else h)
    if len(b) != 32:
        raise ValueError("not 32 bytes")
    return b


def digest(version, firmware, manifest):
    """D for this release. version: year.month.n; firmware, manifest: 32 bytes (or hex)."""
    global _domain
    if _domain is None:
        _domain = keccak256(keccak256(b"EIP712Domain(string name,string version)") + keccak256(b"PicoQuorum Release") + keccak256(b"1"))
    struct = keccak256(keccak256(b"PicoQuorumRelease(string version,bytes32 firmware,bytes32 manifest)")
                       + keccak256(version.encode()) + _b32(firmware) + _b32(manifest))
    return keccak256(b"\x19\x01" + _domain + struct)


def valid_version(v):
    """year.month.n, as firmware/manifest.json writes it."""
    p = v.split(".") if isinstance(v, str) else []
    return len(p) == 3 and all(x and all(ch in VERSION_CHARS for ch in x) for x in p) and len(p[0]) == 4 and len(v) <= 16


def from_origin(origin):
    """The release a transaction's origin note names: {"pq": {"v": version, "f": firmware, "m":
    manifest}} (short keys: Safe's service keeps 200 characters). -> (version, firmware, manifest)
    as given, or None when the note names no release."""
    import json
    if isinstance(origin, str):
        try:
            origin = json.loads(origin)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    if not isinstance(origin, dict) or not isinstance(origin.get("pq"), dict):
        return None
    r = origin["pq"]
    v, f, m = r.get("v"), r.get("f"), r.get("m")
    if not (isinstance(v, str) and isinstance(f, str) and isinstance(m, str)):
        return None
    return v, f, m

# PLAY SNAKE, in the LAB: the flip-phone classic, and a small honest lesson about randomness.
# Every press you make while the game is open goes into a pool (which key, how many 50 ms ticks
# since the last press, the microsecond clock). Every apple after the first is placed from a
# SHA-256 of that pool, so the game visibly runs on your own randomness. When a game ends, A
# shows the report on the LAB's answer screen: how many bits the presses were worth (NIST SP
# 800-90B's most common value rule on the gaps, with its small-sample bound), the pool digest,
# and how the chip's own Random compares. Nothing here becomes a key.
#
# High scores: a top-10 table with three-letter initials, kept in snake.top on the Pico and written
# into DATA slot 13 of the chip (72 bytes, the free clear slot under the wallet config; 12 is the
# note's). While the data zone is open the chip takes the table but refuses to read it back; after
# the data lock the chip's copy is read first and becomes the working copy. A chip write is a
# REVERSIBLE change and the initials box says so before A confirms it.
#
# A view of the chip UI (slots.py): draw(ui) and tick(ui, pressed) on the wallet's 50 ms timer,
# ui.n as the only clock, ui.d as the screen. During play the whole screen is the green panel.
# Keys: stick steers, A starts (and opens the report after a game), B or the stick press pauses,
# Y quits to the LAB. B and Y reach this view on press, not on release (slots.py skips arm_tick).
# The standalone version with its own Timer is emu/sketches/snake.py.
import time, math, hashlib, json
import lcd as L
import chipmap as C
import atecc

BG = L.color(196, 232, 200)   # the backlit green of the old Nokia panel
INK = L.color(40, 56, 40)     # its pixels
CELL = 10
COLS, ROWS = 22, 20           # 220 x 200 field
OX, OY = 10, 30               # field origin on the screen
HI_FILE = "snake.hi"          # the old single number; read once to seed the table
TOP_FILE = "snake.top"        # the table, JSON [[initials, score], ...] best first
TOP_N = 10
SLOT = 13                     # the chip's clear DATA slot the table goes into
MAGIC = b"SNK1"               # 4 + 10 x 6 = 64 bytes: two 32-byte blocks
LETTERS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ-"
START_TICKS, MIN_TICKS = 4, 2 # a move every 200 ms at first, 100 ms at most; one tick is 50 ms
BONUS_EVERY, BONUS_MOVES = 5, 30
FIRST_FOOD = 6 * COLS + 15    # before any press there is nothing to draw from
FIXED = bytes([0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00]) * 8   # what Random answers while the rules are open
KEYCODE = {"up": 1, "down": 2, "left": 3, "right": 4, "A": 5, "B": 6, "press": 7}
DIRS = {"up": (0, -1), "down": (0, 1), "left": (-1, 0), "right": (1, 0)}

state = "title"               # title, play, pause, dead, name, over, scores
body = []                     # cells as col + row * COLS, head last
grid = bytearray(COLS * ROWS)
heading = (1, 0)
queue = []                    # pending turns, at most 2
food = -1
bonus = -1                    # left cell of the bonus bug, -1 when none
bonus_left = 0
eaten = 0
score = 0
hi = 0
top = []                      # [[initials, score], ...] best first, at most TOP_N
initials = "AAA"              # the letters being entered (start from the last ones)
cursor = 0                    # which letter
rank = 0                      # the place the score is going into, 1-based
chip_note = ""                # what the chip did with the table, for the SCORES screen
chip_ok = None                # True written/read, False refused, None no chip or not tried
prev = "title"                # where the SCORES screen goes back to
_ui = None                    # the SlotsUI, for the chip and the slot table
next_n = 0                    # ui.n of the next move (or blink step)
blink = 0
play_ticks = 0                # ticks spent in play since the LAB row was opened
fake = []                     # key names pushed by inject(), read by tick like real presses

# the pool, since the LAB row was opened
pool = bytearray()
hist = [0] * 64               # how often each gap (in ticks, 63 = 3 s or more) came up
N = 0                         # gaps in the histogram: presses minus the first, which has none
presses = 0
last_n = 0


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- the pool
def sample(k, n):
    """One press: 7 bytes into the pool, one count into the gap histogram. No hashing here."""
    global N, presses, last_n, pool
    gap = n - last_n if last_n else 0
    if last_n:
        hist[min(gap, 63)] += 1     # the first press has nothing to be a gap from
        N += 1
    last_n = n
    presses += 1
    pool.append(KEYCODE[k])
    pool.append(gap >> 8 & 0xFF)
    pool.append(gap & 0xFF)
    pool.extend((time.ticks_us() & 0xFFFFFFFF).to_bytes(4, "little"))
    if len(pool) > 2048:
        pool = bytearray(hashlib.sha256(pool).digest())   # fold; N and hist keep counting


def digest():
    return hashlib.sha256(pool).digest()


def estimate():
    """Bits a press and in all, by the most common gap: (per, total, mode_gap, mode_count).
    NIST SP 800-90B most common value: -log2 of the 99% upper bound on the likeliest gap's share."""
    if N < 2:
        return 0.0, 0.0, (hist.index(1) if N else 0), N
    m = max(hist)
    g = hist.index(m)
    p = m / N
    pu = min(1.0, p + 2.576 * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / (N - 1)))
    per = 0.0 if pu >= 1.0 else -math.log(pu) / math.log(2)
    return per, min(256.0, per * N), g, m


def numbers():
    """For the REPL and the emulator: (presses, gaps, mode_gap, mode_count, bits_per_press, total_bits, digest_hex)."""
    per, total, g, m = estimate()
    return (presses, N, g, m, per, total, "".join("%02x" % b for b in digest()))


def reset_pool():
    global pool, N, presses, last_n, play_ticks
    pool = bytearray()
    for i in range(64):
        hist[i] = 0
    N = 0
    presses = 0
    last_n = 0
    play_ticks = 0


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- the game
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- the table
def load_top():
    """snake.top from flash; an old snake.hi seeds it once as '---'. hi is the top score."""
    global top, hi
    top = []
    try:
        top = [[str(a)[:3], int(b)] for a, b in json.load(open(TOP_FILE))][:TOP_N]
    except Exception:
        try:
            h = int(open(HI_FILE).read())
            if h > 0:
                top = [["---", h]]
        except Exception:
            pass
    hi = top[0][1] if top else 0


def save_top():
    global hi
    hi = top[0][1] if top else 0
    try:
        with open(TOP_FILE, "w") as f:
            json.dump(top, f)
    except Exception:
        pass


def pack_top(t):
    """The table as the 64 bytes slot 13 holds: MAGIC, then 6 bytes an entry (3 letters, score, pad)."""
    b = bytearray(MAGIC)
    for name, score in t[:TOP_N]:
        b += (name + "---")[:3].encode() + min(int(score), 65535).to_bytes(2, "little") + b"\x00"
    return bytes(b) + bytes(64 - len(b))


def unpack_top(b):
    """The table back from those bytes, or None when they are not a table."""
    b = bytes(b)
    if len(b) < 10 or b[:4] != MAGIC:
        return None
    t = []
    for i in range(4, len(b) - 5, 6):
        name, score = b[i:i + 3], b[i + 3] | b[i + 4] << 8
        if score == 0:
            break
        try:
            t.append([name.decode(), score])
        except Exception:
            return None
    return t


def qualifies(score):
    return score > 0 and (len(top) < TOP_N or score > top[-1][1])


def place(score):
    """1-based rank a score would take: after every entry that ties or beats it."""
    n = 0
    for _, s in top:
        if s >= score:
            n += 1
    return n + 1


def chip_slot(ui):
    """The chip, if the table can go there: config locked, slot 13's rules say clear and not secret."""
    chip = getattr(ui.sig, "chip", None)
    if chip is None or not ui.st.get("configLocked"):
        return None
    s = ui.row(SLOT)
    if s.get("clearWrite") != "clear" or s.get("isSecret"):
        return None
    return chip


def refused(ui, e):
    status = getattr(e, "status", None)
    if status is None:
        return "chip: %s" % e
    return "chip refused (0x%02X): %s" % (status, atecc.explain(status))


def chip_save(ui):
    """The table into slot 13, two 32-byte blocks. What happened goes to chip_note for the SCORES screen."""
    global chip_note, chip_ok
    chip = chip_slot(ui)
    if chip is None:
        chip_note, chip_ok = "kept on the Pico only: no clear data slot on the bus", None
        return
    b = pack_top(top)
    try:
        chip.write_data(SLOT, 0, b[:32])
        chip.write_data(SLOT, 1, b[32:])
        chip_ok = True
        if ui.st.get("dataLocked"):
            chip_note = "chip slot %d holds it: 64 bytes, written in clear" % SLOT
        else:
            chip_note = "chip slot %d holds it; it reads back after the data lock" % SLOT
    except Exception as e:
        chip_ok = False
        chip_note = refused(ui, e)


def chip_load(ui):
    """After the data lock the chip's copy is the working copy; before it the chip cannot answer."""
    global top, chip_note, chip_ok
    chip = chip_slot(ui)
    if chip is None:
        chip_note, chip_ok = "kept on the Pico only: no clear data slot on the bus", None
        return
    if not ui.st.get("dataLocked"):
        chip_note, chip_ok = "chip slot %d: written on each new score, read back after the data lock" % SLOT, None
        return
    try:
        t = unpack_top(chip.read_data(SLOT, 0) + chip.read_data(SLOT, 1))
    except Exception as e:
        chip_note, chip_ok = refused(ui, e), False
        return
    if t is None:
        chip_note, chip_ok = "chip slot %d holds no table yet; the next score writes one" % SLOT, None
    elif t == top:
        chip_note, chip_ok = "chip slot %d holds this table, read back in clear" % SLOT, True
    else:
        top = t[:TOP_N]
        save_top()
        chip_note, chip_ok = "chip slot %d held a different table; the chip's copy wins" % SLOT, True


def commit(ui, name):
    """A finished entry: into the table, to flash, to the chip."""
    global initials, state
    initials = name
    top.insert(place(score) - 1, [name, score])
    del top[TOP_N:]
    save_top()
    chip_save(ui)
    state = "over"


def taken(i):
    return grid[i] or i == food or (bonus >= 0 and (i == bonus or i == bonus + 1))


def fits(i, width):
    if width == 2 and i % COLS == COLS - 1:
        return False
    return not taken(i) and (width == 1 or not taken(i + 1))


def free_cell(width=1):
    """An empty cell drawn from the pool; with width 2 the cell to its right is empty too."""
    if N == 0 and eaten == 0:
        return FIRST_FOOD
    h = hashlib.sha256(pool + bytes([eaten & 0xFF, width])).digest()
    n = ROWS * COLS
    for j in range(0, 32, 2):
        i = (h[j] << 8 | h[j + 1]) % n
        if fits(i, width):
            return i
    i = (h[0] << 8 | h[1]) % n
    for _ in range(n):
        i = (i + 1) % n
        if fits(i, width):
            return i
    return -1


def period():
    return max(MIN_TICKS, START_TICKS - eaten // 5)


def reset(n):
    global body, heading, queue, food, bonus, bonus_left, eaten, score, next_n
    for i in range(len(grid)):
        grid[i] = 0
    r = ROWS // 2
    body = [r * COLS + c for c in range(8, 12)]   # 4 long, heading right
    for i in body:
        grid[i] = 1
    heading = (1, 0)
    queue = []
    food = -1
    bonus = -1
    bonus_left = 0
    eaten = 0
    score = 0
    food = free_cell()
    next_n = n + period()


def turn(k):
    d = DIRS[k]
    last = queue[-1] if queue else heading
    if d == last or (d[0] == -last[0] and d[1] == -last[1]):
        return
    if len(queue) < 2:
        queue.append(d)


def die(n):
    global state, blink, next_n
    state = "dead"
    blink = 6
    next_n = n + 2


def move(n):
    global heading, food, bonus, bonus_left, eaten, score, hi
    if queue:
        heading = queue.pop(0)
    head = body[-1]
    c = head % COLS + heading[0]
    r = head // COLS + heading[1]
    if c < 0 or c >= COLS or r < 0 or r >= ROWS:
        return die(n)
    i = r * COLS + c
    ate = i == food
    got = bonus >= 0 and (i == bonus or i == bonus + 1)
    if not ate and not got:
        grid[body.pop(0)] = 0           # tail moves first, so chasing it is allowed
    if grid[i]:
        return die(n)
    body.append(i)
    grid[i] = 1
    if ate:
        eaten += 1
        score += 10
        food = -1
        food = free_cell()
        if eaten % BONUS_EVERY == 0 and bonus < 0:
            bonus = free_cell(2)
            bonus_left = BONUS_MOVES
    if got:
        score += bonus_left * 10
        bonus = -1
    elif bonus >= 0:
        bonus_left -= 1
        if bonus_left <= 0:
            bonus = -1
    if score > hi:
        hi = score


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
def cell_xy(i):
    return OX + (i % COLS) * CELL, OY + (i // COLS) * CELL


def draw_border(d):
    d.rect(OX - 2, OY - 2, COLS * CELL + 4, ROWS * CELL + 4, INK)
    d.rect(OX - 1, OY - 1, COLS * CELL + 2, ROWS * CELL + 2, INK)


def draw_snake(d, cells, head_dir):
    for i in cells:
        x, y = cell_xy(i)
        d.fill_rect(x + 1, y + 1, CELL - 2, CELL - 2, INK)
    x, y = cell_xy(cells[-1])
    d.fill_rect(x, y, CELL, CELL, INK)
    dx, dy = head_dir
    if dx:
        ex = x + (6 if dx > 0 else 2)
        d.fill_rect(ex, y + 2, 2, 2, BG)
        d.fill_rect(ex, y + 6, 2, 2, BG)
    else:
        ey = y + (6 if dy > 0 else 2)
        d.fill_rect(x + 2, ey, 2, 2, BG)
        d.fill_rect(x + 6, ey, 2, 2, BG)


def draw_field(d, show_snake=True):
    d.fill(BG)
    d.big_text("%04d" % score, OX, 7, INK, 2)
    if bonus >= 0:
        d.big_text("%02d" % bonus_left, 198, 7, INK, 2)
    else:
        d.text("HI %04d" % hi, 174, 11, INK)
    draw_border(d)
    if food >= 0:
        x, y = cell_xy(food)
        d.rect(x + 2, y + 2, 6, 6, INK)
        d.fill_rect(x + 4, y + 4, 2, 2, INK)
    if bonus >= 0:
        x, y = cell_xy(bonus)
        d.ellipse(x + 10, y + 5, 6, 3, INK, True)
        for lx in (x + 3, x + 15):
            d.fill_rect(lx, y + 1, 2, 2, INK)
            d.fill_rect(lx, y + 7, 2, 2, INK)
    if show_snake and body:
        draw_snake(d, body, heading)


def box(d, w, h):
    x, y = (240 - w) // 2, (240 - h) // 2
    d.fill_rect(x, y, w, h, BG)
    d.rect(x, y, w, h, INK)
    d.rect(x + 2, y + 2, w - 4, h - 4, INK)
    return y


def draw_title(d):
    d.fill(BG)
    draw_border(d)
    d.center_text("SNAKE", 50, INK, 4)
    r = 10
    draw_snake(d, [r * COLS + c for c in range(5, 12)], (1, 0))
    x, y = cell_xy(r * COLS + 15)
    d.rect(x + 2, y + 2, 6, 6, INK)
    d.fill_rect(x + 4, y + 4, 2, 2, INK)
    d.center_text("every press feeds a pool", 150, INK)
    d.center_text("the apples come from it", 162, INK)
    d.center_text("A  start", 184, INK)
    d.center_text(("HI %04d %s     X scores" % (hi, top[0][0])) if top else "no scores yet    X scores", 198, INK)
    d.center_text("stick steer  B pause  Y quit", 214, INK)


def draw(ui):
    d = ui.d
    if state == "title":
        draw_title(d)
    elif state == "play":
        draw_field(d)
    elif state == "pause":
        draw_field(d)
        y = box(d, 120, 40)
        d.center_text("PAUSED", y + 12, INK, 2)
    elif state == "dead":
        draw_field(d, blink % 2 == 0)
    elif state == "name":
        draw_field(d)
        draw_name(d, ui)
    elif state == "scores":
        draw_scores(d)
    else:
        draw_field(d)
        y = box(d, 180, 96)
        d.center_text("GAME OVER", y + 12, INK, 2)
        d.center_text("SCORE %04d  HI %04d" % (score, hi), y + 40, INK)
        d.center_text("A report   B again", y + 60, INK)
        d.center_text("X scores   Y quit", y + 76, INK)


def draw_name(d, ui):
    """The arcade box: rank, score, three big letters with the cursor under one, and the class of
    what A will do (a chip write is a REVERSIBLE change; it says so before it happens)."""
    y = box(d, 220, 150)
    d.center_text("NEW HIGH SCORE  #%d" % rank, y + 10, INK)
    d.center_text("%04d" % score, y + 24, INK, 2)
    x0 = 120 - 66
    for i in range(3):
        x = x0 + i * 44 + 6
        d.big_text(initials[i], x, y + 50, INK, 4)
        if i == cursor:
            d.fill_rect(x, y + 86, 32, 3, INK)
    if chip_slot(ui):
        C.badge(d, "rev", 18, y + 100)
        d.text("REVERSIBLE: chip slot %d" % SLOT, 32, y + 100, INK)
        d.text("and the Pico's flash", 32, y + 112, INK)
    else:
        C.badge(d, "safe", 18, y + 100)
        d.text("kept on the Pico only", 32, y + 100, INK)
    d.center_text("up/dn  A next  Y skip", y + 132, INK)


def draw_scores(d):
    d.fill(BG)
    draw_border(d)
    d.center_text("HIGH SCORES", 30, INK, 2)
    y = 52
    for i in range(TOP_N):
        if i < len(top):
            d.text("#%2d  %s  %04d" % (i + 1, top[i][0], top[i][1]), 56, y, INK)
        else:
            d.text("#%2d  ---  ----" % (i + 1), 56, y, INK)
        y += 12
    y += 6
    for line in C.wrap(chip_note, 27)[:3]:
        d.text(line, 16, y, INK); y += 11
    d.center_text("Y back", 216, INK)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- input
def enter(ui):
    """The LAB row: a fresh pool, the table from flash and the chip, the title screen. (Not named
    open: that would shadow the builtin this module reads its files with.)"""
    global state, _ui
    _ui = ui
    reset_pool()
    load_top()
    chip_load(ui)
    state = "title"
    ui.armhold = None
    ui.pend.clear()
    ui.go("snake")


def tick(ui, pressed):
    global state, blink, next_n, play_ticks, prev, cursor, rank
    n = ui.n
    ks = list(pressed)
    if fake:
        ks += fake
        del fake[:]
    for k in ks:
        if state == "scores":
            if k in ("Y", "X", "A", "B"):
                state = prev
                ui.dirty = True
            continue
        if k == "X" and state in ("title", "over"):
            prev, state = state, "scores"
            ui.dirty = True
            continue
        if state == "name":
            if k in KEYCODE:
                sample(k, n)
            name_key(ui, k)
            continue
        if k == "Y":
            ui.back()
            return
        if k not in KEYCODE:
            continue
        sample(k, n)
        if state == "title" or state == "over":
            if k == "A" or k in DIRS or (k == "B" and state == "over"):
                if k == "A" and state == "over":
                    report(ui)
                    return
                reset(n)
                state = "play"
                if k in DIRS:
                    turn(k)
                ui.dirty = True
        elif state == "play":
            if k in DIRS:
                turn(k)
            elif k == "B" or k == "press":
                state = "pause"
                ui.dirty = True
        elif state == "pause":
            if k in ("B", "press", "A"):
                state = "play"
                next_n = n + period()
                ui.dirty = True
    if state == "play":
        play_ticks += 1
        if n >= next_n:
            move(n)
            if state == "play":
                next_n = n + period()
            ui.dirty = True
    elif state == "dead" and n >= next_n:
        blink -= 1
        if blink <= 0:
            if qualifies(score):
                state, cursor, rank = "name", 0, place(score)
            else:
                state = "over"
        else:
            next_n = n + 2
        ui.dirty = True


def name_key(ui, k):
    """The initials box: up/down cycle the letter, left/right move, A next (the third A commits),
    Y skips and files the score as ---."""
    global initials, cursor
    if k == "up" or k == "down":
        i = LETTERS.index(initials[cursor]) if initials[cursor] in LETTERS else 0
        i = (i + (1 if k == "down" else -1)) % len(LETTERS)
        initials = initials[:cursor] + LETTERS[i] + initials[cursor + 1:]
    elif k == "left":
        cursor = max(0, cursor - 1)
    elif k == "right":
        cursor = min(2, cursor + 1)
    elif k == "A" or k == "press":
        if cursor < 2:
            cursor += 1
        else:
            commit(ui, initials)
    elif k == "Y":
        commit(ui, "---")
    ui.dirty = True


def inject(*names):
    """Queue key presses for the next tick, e.g. snakelab.inject("A", "up") from the REPL."""
    fake.extend(names)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- the report
def report(ui):
    """The pool as a LAB answer: the count in words, the digest as the bytes, the method as WHY."""
    global state
    per, total, g, m = estimate()
    raw_total = per * N
    secs = play_ticks * 50 // 1000
    text = "%d presses in %d s. What you control is the gap between them: %d ticks came up %d of %d times, so about %.1f bits a press. " % (presses, secs, g, m, N, per)
    if N < 20:
        text += "Too few presses to trust the count."
    elif raw_total > 256:
        text += "Total ~%d bits, capped at 256 here." % raw_total
    elif total < 128:
        text += "~%d bits: not a key yet. Play longer." % total
    else:
        text += "~%d bits in all." % total
    chip = getattr(ui.sig, "chip", None)
    trace = None
    if chip is None:
        cmp = "There is no chip on the bus to compare with."
    else:
        try:
            r = chip.random()
            trace = chip.trace
            ms = trace["ms"] if trace else 25
            if r == FIXED:
                cmp = "The chip's Random took %d ms for 32 bytes: ffff0000 repeated, the test pattern of a chip whose rules are still open." % ms
            else:
                cmp = "The chip's Random took %d ms for 32 real bytes; you took %d s for about %d." % (ms, secs, total)
        except Exception as e:
            cmp = "The chip refused Random: %s." % e
    gaps = sorted(((hist[i], i) for i in range(64) if hist[i]), reverse=True)[:6]
    why = ("Smaller than it looks. Every press put 7 bytes in the pool: which key, how many 50 ms ticks since the last press, "
           "and the microsecond clock. Only the gap is counted. The key is what the game made you press; the clock is the "
           "wallet's timer, not you. Gaps are whole ticks, so there are at most 64 sizes: 6 bits a press is the ceiling and "
           "a person lands near 2. NIST SP 800-90B's most common value rule: if the likeliest gap has share p, a press is "
           "worth at most -log2(p) bits, and with few presses p is pushed up first (a 99%% bound). Here: gaps %s. "
           "%d gaps x %.1f = ~%d bits; SHA-256 keeps 256 at most. %s The first apple is always in the same place: "
           "you had not pressed anything yet. Every apple after it came from the hash of your presses so far, so no two "
           "games look alike. Nothing here becomes a key. A wallet key comes from the chip's generator, never from a game."
           % (" ".join("%dx%d" % (i, c) for c, i in gaps) or "none", N, per, raw_total, cmp))
    ui.lab = {"q": "PLAY SNAKE", "cmd": "make randomness yourself", "text": text, "raw": digest(), "why": why,
              "trace": trace, "icon": "snake", "whylabel": "HOW IT WAS COUNTED >"}
    state = "title"
    ui.ret, ui.view, ui.act2, ui.dirty = "snake", "labres", 0, True

files.text:
# Boot display: a short black lead-in, then the PicoQuorum mark with the real boot status on its
# last line. secrets.BOOT_ART picks the art: "mark" (the default, bootmark.py: flat vectors, only
# what changed is sent to the panel, runs on every panel), "still" (the finished mark at once) or
# "orbit" (bootart.py: the full orbit, the whole panel every frame, ~8-10 fps on the Pico; strip-
# buffered 240-row panels only, others get the mark) or "checklist" (the chip and a row per step,
# no art). The console calls finish before starting its
# timer/watchdog, releasing the art's code before normal transaction-service polling.
import time
import lcd as L
import theme as T
import icons as I

lcd = None
TITLE = "picowallet"   # the app that boots sets its own name (quorum.py: "picoquorum")
rows = []           # [key, text, color], drawn in ORDER
ORDER = ("screen", "wifi", "chip", "app")
ICON = {"screen": "screen", "wifi": "wifi", "chip": "chip", "app": "app"}
BLACK_LEAD_MS = 4000    # the orbit's; the mark sets its own (begin)
ANIMATION_MS = 9600
_t0 = 0
_frame = 0
_last = 0
_art = None
_still = False
_gap = 120          # spin redraws at most this often (ms): the orbit is a whole frame, the mark is not
_finished = False
_status = "Starting up"
_status_color = (152, 160, 172)
_waiting = None     # the row that is spinning, if any
_timer = None       # run(): the art draws itself on a soft timer while the console starts
_busy = False       # a frame is being drawn: the timer skips its turn rather than nest
_paused = False     # pause(): the timer draws nothing (around the console's big allocations)


def run(period=30):
    """Keep the art moving by itself: a soft timer draws a frame every period ms, between the
    Python steps of whatever runs meanwhile, so boot.py need not wait for WiFi and the console's
    start (imports, the chip) goes on under a moving screen. One core and no thread on purpose:
    MicroPython's second core on the RP2 has no GIL and its garbage collector does not stop the
    other core, so two cores allocating can free an object in use. A soft timer runs where the VM
    is between bytecodes, every object rooted. Only C work (an .mpy loading) holds a frame up.
    finish() or stop() ends it."""
    global _timer
    if _art is None or _timer is not None or _finished:
        return
    from machine import Timer
    _timer = Timer(period=period, mode=Timer.PERIODIC, callback=_tick)


def _tick(_t):
    if _busy or _paused or _finished:
        return
    try:
        draw()
    except Exception as e:      # a broken frame stops the animation, never the boot
        print("splash:", e)
        stop()


def stop():
    """No more frames from the timer (finish(), and main.py's error screen)."""
    global _timer
    if _timer is not None:
        _timer.deinit()
        _timer = None


def pause(on=True):
    global _paused
    _paused = on


def _choice():
    try:
        import secrets
        return getattr(secrets, "BOOT_ART", "mark")
    except ImportError:
        return "mark"


def begin():
    """The LCD, created once. Safe to call again: returns the same one."""
    global lcd, _t0, _art, _still, _gap, BLACK_LEAD_MS, ANIMATION_MS
    if lcd is None:
        lcd = L.LCD()
        # Clear every strip once; leave it black while the rest of startup proceeds.
        lcd.frames(_black)
        art = _choice()
        if art == "orbit" and L.H >= 200 and L.BANDS > 1:
            # The orbit needs the strip buffer: on a single 115 KB frame it ran the heap out
            # (MemoryError in bootart.render, 2026-09-29).
            import bootart
            _art = bootart
        elif art != "checklist":
            import bootmark
            _art, _gap = bootmark, 30
            _still = art == "still"
            BLACK_LEAD_MS = bootmark.LEAD_MS
            ANIMATION_MS = 0 if _still else bootmark.DURATION_MS
        _t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        step("screen", "ok", L.GREEN)
    return lcd


def step(key, text, color=L.WHITE):
    """Set a row (rows appear in ORDER as they are first set) and redraw."""
    global _waiting, _status, _status_color
    _status = key + ": " + text
    _status_color = (255, 92, 84) if color == L.RED else (152, 160, 172)
    for r in rows:
        if r[0] == key:
            r[1], r[2] = text, color
            break
    else:
        rows.append([key, text, color])
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: ORDER.index(r[0]) if r[0] in ORDER else 9)
    if _waiting == key and color != L.GREY:
        _waiting = None
    if _timer is None:          # with the timer running, its next frame shows it
        draw()


def chip(seed, text, ok=True):
    """The chip the console read: its owner's blockie and a short line under the name (the mark only;
    the other boot screens list it as the chip row). seed: the owner address."""
    if _art is not None and hasattr(_art, "set_chip"):
        _art.set_chip(seed, text, ok)
        if _timer is None:
            draw()


def spin(key, text):
    """A row that is waiting: call it as often as you like, it redraws at most ~8 times a second."""
    global _last, _waiting
    now = time.ticks_ms()
    if time.ticks_diff(now, _last) < _gap:
        return
    _last = now
    _waiting = key
    step(key, text, L.GREY)


def wifi_row(wlan, ssid):
    if wlan.isconnected():
        step("wifi", wlan.ifconfig()[0], L.GREEN)
    else:
        step("wifi", "not found, retrying" if ssid else "no Wi-Fi saved", L.RED)


def draw():
    """One frame. Each call advances the leg chase, so a periodic redraw animates it."""
    global _frame, _busy
    if lcd is None:
        return
    _frame += 1
    if _finished or _busy:
        return
    _busy = True
    try:
        _draw_frame()
    finally:
        _busy = False


def _draw_frame():
    if _art is not None:
        elapsed = time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), _t0) - BLACK_LEAD_MS
        if elapsed < 0:
            return
        try:
            if getattr(_art, "IN_MS", False):          # the mark: time in ms
                _art.render(lcd, elapsed, _status, _status_color, _still)
            else:                                       # the orbit: its frame, 30 ms each
                _art.render(lcd, elapsed // 30, _status, _status_color)
        except MemoryError:
            # A frame of the animation is not worth the console: the Trust M's certificate checks leave
            # the heap in pieces (MemoryError in bootart.render on the 240x240 board, 2026-09-30). Skip it.
            # The mark keeps what it last sent until a frame completes, so the next one repaints the rest.
            _skipped()
    else:
        try:
            lcd.frames(_draw)
        except MemoryError:
            _skipped()


def _skipped():
    import gc
    lcd.y0 = 0
    gc.collect()


def _black():
    lcd.fill(L.BLACK)
    lcd.show()


def _draw():
    d = lcd
    T.gradient(d, 0, L.H, T.RGB["navy"], T.RGB["bg"])
    # the die: 48 px body, 8 legs a side, one colour of the rainbow per leg walking round
    small = L.H < 200       # the 1.8": the die, the name and four short rows in 128 px
    cx, cy = L.W // 2, 26 if small else 42
    if _waiting:
        r = 34 + (_frame % 3) * 2
        d.ellipse(cx, cy, r, r, T.shade("config", 0.5))
    d.fill_rect(cx - 24, cy - 24, 48, 48, T.C["ink"])
    d.rect(cx - 24, cy - 24, 48, 48, T.C["chip"])
    d.fill_rect(cx - 18, cy - 18, 5, 5, T.C["learn"])
    I.draw(d, "chip", cx - 8, cy - 8, T.shade("chip", 0.6))
    for i in range(8):
        y = cy - 21 + i * 6
        left = T.C[T.RAINBOW[(_frame + i) % 7]] if _waiting or _frame < 40 else T.C["dim"]
        right = T.C[T.RAINBOW[(_frame + 15 - i) % 7]] if _waiting or _frame < 40 else T.C["dim"]
        d.fill_rect(cx - 33, y, 9, 3, left)
        d.fill_rect(cx + 24, y, 9, 3, right)
    d.center_text(TITLE, 56 if small else 76, L.WHITE, 2)
    done = sum(1 for r in rows if r[2] == L.GREEN)
    x0, yb = L.W // 2 - 80, 74 if small else 96
    d.fill_rect(x0, yb, 160, 3, T.C["ink"])
    d.fill_rect(x0, yb, 40 * done, 3, T.C["learn"])
    if small:
        y = 82
        for key, text, color in rows:
            d.fill_rect(4, y + 2, 4, 4, color if color != L.GREY else T.C["config"])
            d.text((key + " " + text)[:(L.W - 14) // 8], 12, y, color)
            y += 11
        d.show()
        return
    y, ox = 110, (L.W - 240) // 2
    for key, text, color in rows:
        I.draw(d, ICON.get(key, "chip"), ox + 20, y - 4, color if color != L.GREY else T.C["config"])
        d.text(text[:24], ox + 44, y, color)
        y += 20
    d.text("%.1fs" % (time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), _t0) / 1000), 4, L.H - 12, T.C["dim"])
    d.show()


def finish(keys=None, wait=True):
    """Let the branding reach the name (the mark: 0.3 s black + 3.7 s; the orbit: 4 s + 9.6 s); any key skips.
    Called before the console starts its timer/watchdog. Release animation code before TLS.
    Errors bypass this hold and go straight to the console's error screen.
    """
    global _art, _finished
    stop()                      # from here this loop draws, as without the timer
    if _art is None:
        return
    import gc
    import sys
    try:
        while wait and time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), _t0) < BLACK_LEAD_MS + ANIMATION_MS:
            if keys is not None and keys.pressed():
                break
            draw()
            time.sleep_ms(10)
    finally:
        _finished = True
        _art = None
        sys.modules.pop("bootart", None)
        sys.modules.pop("bootmark", None)
        sys.modules.pop("taglines", None)
        gc.collect()

files.text:
# The boot screen's taglines: one under the name on the mark (bootmark.py), a cycle of them on the
# orbit (bootart.py). secrets.BOOT_TAGLINES picks the pool: "serious" (the default), "fun", "all"
# or "none". Each must fit 220 px in sans14 (test-vectors/run-bootmark.mjs checks).
# SERIOUS lines are claims about this console, so each must stay true of the firmware:
#   the hash: safe_tx.py rebuilds the safeTxHash from the fields shown, and the console refuses a
#     transaction whose hash the service lies about (txservice.py)
#   the key: made inside the chip (GenKey), never leaves it, never a seed phrase
#   the screen: decode.py turns calldata into plain words; red pages for the dangerous ones
#   the code: the hash's last 8 characters, to read to a co-signer (safe_tx.verify_code)
import random

SERIOUS = (
    "See what you sign",
    "Nothing signs unseen",
    "Every hash checked here",
    "Computes its own Safe hash",
    "If the service lies, it's refused",
    "Don't trust. Verify.",
    "Plain words, not hex",
    "Read it. Then sign it.",
    "Compare the code, then sign",
    "Keys born in silicon",
    "The key never leaves the chip",
    "No seed phrase. Ever.",
    "Your keys, your quorum",
    "Several keys, one Safe",
    "Hardware approvals for Safe",
    "Deliberate by design",
)

FUN = (
    "Hack the planet!",                     # Hackers (1995)
    "The bear is sticky with honey",        # Silicon Valley
    "Middle-out signing",                   # Silicon Valley
    "Making the world a better place",      # Silicon Valley
    "There is no seed phrase",              # The Matrix: there is no spoon (and there isn't)
    "Follow the white rabbit",              # The Matrix
    "Shall we play a game?",                # WarGames
    "The only winning move is to verify",   # WarGames
    "Too many secrets",                     # Sneakers
    "It's a Unix system! I know this!",     # Jurassic Park
    "Hello, friend.",                       # Mr. Robot
    "I'm in.",                              # every hacker film
    "All your keys are belong to you",      # Zero Wing
    "Trust no one. Verify everything.",     # The X-Files, roughly
    "In silicon we trust",
    "High tech, low trust",                 # cyberpunk: high tech, low life
    "Jack in. Sign off.",
    "Wetware approves, hardware signs",
    "Greetz to the quorum",                 # the demoscene
    "Not your keys, not your coins",
)


def pool():
    try:
        import secrets
        kind = getattr(secrets, "BOOT_TAGLINES", "serious")
    except ImportError:
        kind = "serious"
    return {"serious": SERIOUS, "fun": FUN, "all": SERIOUS + FUN}.get(kind, ())


def pick():
    """One tagline for this boot, or "" for none."""
    p = pool()
    return random.choice(p) if p else ""


def cycle():
    """The whole pool, from a random place in it (MicroPython's random has no shuffle)."""
    p = pool()
    if not p:
        return ("",)
    i = random.getrandbits(8) % len(p)
    return p[i:] + p[:i]
